title: A2P Campaign Credential
description: A credential issued to an organization that represents a registered A2P messaging campaign and the telephone numbers associated with that campaign.

v.description: Version string using ACDC conventions, encoding protocol, serialization, and size.

d.description: SAID of the credential (Blake3-256 digest in CESR compact encoding).

u.description: A salty nonce (high-entropy random value) used to prevent rainbow-table attacks on the credential SAID.

i.description: AID of the issuer (the party asserting the campaign).

ri.description: SAID of the issuer's ACDC credential status registry.

s.description: SAID of this schema (Blake3-256 digest in CESR compact encoding).

d.description: SAID of the attributes block (Blake3-256 digest in CESR compact encoding).

u.description: A salty nonce for the attributes block, enabling selective disclosure.

i.description: AID of the organization approved to originate traffic for this campaign.

dt.description: Issuance date-time (when the ACDC was signed), as an ISO-8601 datetime string with timezone.

brandId.description: Legal identifier for the organization approved for the campaign -- e.g., an LEI, ISIN code, S&P company ID, DUNS number, etc.

campaignId.description: Unique campaign identifier assigned by the campaign approval authority or registry.

usecase.description: Campaign use case category. Values should align with the applicable campaign registry or governance framework.

startDate.description: Campaign start date-time, as an ISO-8601 datetime string with timezone.

endDate.description: Campaign expiration date-time, as an ISO-8601 datetime string with timezone.

numbers.description: Array of number expressions representing telephone numbers allocated to the brand. Each expression is either a single E164 number (e.g., '+15551234567') or an inclusive range denoted by a hyphen between two E164 numbers (e.g., '+15551230000-+15551239999').

items.description: A single E164 telephone number or an inclusive range. Single number: '+' followed by 7-15 digits. Range: two E164 numbers separated by a hyphen (e.g., '+15551230000-+15551239999').

authorizedServiceProvider.description: Service provider authorized to originate or manage traffic for this campaign.

campaignAttributes.description: Campaign and content attributes used to evaluate the campaign under the applicable governance framework.

subscriberOptIn.description: Whether the campaign collects and processes subscriber opt-ins.

subscriberOptOut.description: Whether the campaign collects and processes subscriber opt-outs.

subscriberHelp.description: Whether subscribers can contact the sender after sending the HELP keyword or equivalent support request.

embeddedLink.description: Whether campaign messages may contain embedded links.

affiliateMarketing.description: Whether the campaign involves affiliate marketing.

d.description: SAID of the edges block (Blake3-256 digest in CESR compact encoding).

issuer.description: Credential that proves the identity of the issuer.

n.description: SAID of a credential that proves the identity of the issuer.

s.description: SAID of the schema that the issuer identity credential must satisfy.

o.description: Edge operator. I2I (default): issuer AID MUST be the issuee AID of the node this edge points to. NI2I: issuer AID MAY or MAY NOT be the issuee AID of that node. DI2I: issuer AID MUST be the issuee AID or a delegated AID of the issuee AID of that node. NOT: inverts the validity of the node this edge points to.

tnalloc.description: Chain to a Telephone Number Allocation credential proving right to use the campaign telephone numbers.

n.description: SAID of the Telephone Number Allocation credential.

s.description: SAID of the Telephone Number Allocation schema.

o.description: Edge operator. I2I (default): issuer AID MUST be the issuee AID of the node this edge points to. NI2I: issuer AID MAY or MAY NOT be the issuee AID of that node. DI2I: issuer AID MUST be the issuee AID or a delegated AID of the issuee AID of that node. NOT: inverts the validity of the node this edge points to.

brandid.description: Chain to a credential that identifies the brand or organization associated with this campaign.

n.description: SAID of a credential that proves the brand identity.

s.description: SAID of the schema that the brand identity credential must satisfy.

o.description: Edge operator. I2I (default): issuer AID MUST be the issuee AID of the node this edge points to. NI2I: issuer AID MAY or MAY NOT be the issuee AID of that node. DI2I: issuer AID MUST be the issuee AID or a delegated AID of the issuee AID of that node. NOT: inverts the validity of the node this edge points to.

oneOf.description: SAID of rules block (Blake3-256 digest in CESR compact encoding)

d.description: SAID of the rules block (Blake3-256 digest in CESR compact encoding).

governance.description: Statement identifying the governance framework under which this credential was issued.

oneOf.const: Verifiers agree that, if they learn the identity of a brand as a sender of SMS messages by verifying this credential, they will not use this information to infer or model relationships between the brand and service providers.

l.const: Verifiers agree that, if they learn the identity of a brand as a sender of SMS messages by verifying this credential, they will not use this information to infer or model relationships between the brand and service providers.

oneOf.const: Senders of SMS messages agree that their reputation as a sender may be non-repudiably associated with messages that cite this campaign, exactly and only to the extent that the messages are signed by an entity cryptographically authorized to represent the brand.

l.const: Senders of SMS messages agree that their reputation as a sender may be non-repudiably associated with messages that cite this campaign, exactly and only to the extent that the messages are signed by an entity cryptographically authorized to represent the brand.
